implementation.scope: One exact recipient, Homework context, delivery binding, binding revision, Placement, Activity, and Activity Version.
implementation.authority: Current required manifest placements plus persisted trusted terminal-submission facts.
implementation.completionSeparation: Completion is derived only from submitted current required Activities. Grading state, pending review, Activity scores, historical exclusions, and legacy aggregate-grade fields remain separate.
implementation.manifestEvolution: Current-manifest additions and removals are projected without rewriting or discarding historical terminal facts.
implementation.idempotency: Duplicate terminal submission keys replay the existing fact and do not increment completion.
implementation.contextIsolation: Solo and Course/Class runtime contexts do not invoke or populate Homework completion.

studentDataLoadingReview.contract: Student consumes the bounded summary projection; no canonical authority record or per-Activity enrichment is loaded.
studentDataLoadingReview.secondaryEnrichment: None; Activity rows and historical rows are included in the one summary projection.
studentDataLoadingReview.refreshPolicy: One request per homework/student key; cached in-flight request prevents duplicate loads, and the effect resets only when the key or eligibility changes.
studentDataLoadingReview.writeOnRead: None; current-manifest projection is derived in memory from persisted terminal facts.
